boundaries: This is a full std_bench feature-variant diagnostic; many timed closures do not allocate.
Timeouts are retained as censored terminal cells and excluded from cross-allocator ratios.
The raw distribution retains timer-floor leaves; the robust distribution requires every cell median to be at least 100 ns/iter.
Min/max and quantile ranges are descriptive across benchmark leaves, not confidence intervals.
diagnostic_label: current-toolchain complete canonical std_bench inventory; timeout-censored; non-paper-exact

methodology.cell_statistic: median ns/iter of exactly 3 measured fresh processes
methodology.comparison_rule: all seven allocator cells are complete
methodology.robustness_rule: every allocator cell median is at least 100 ns/iter
